title: A Living Hope for Exiles
reflectionText: Peter's praise begins with resurrection and keeps returning to what is held secure: living hope, an unfading inheritance, guarded faith, and promised salvation. Present grief is named without being enlarged, while prophets search, messengers proclaim, and angels desire to look.
editorialNotes: Packet 008 held authoring. Anchor 1 Peter 1:3-12 only; Short and Full by assignment. No circumstances are invented for the recipients or their various trials. The prophets are described as diligently searching whom or what time the Spirit indicated; no complete understanding is attributed to them.
